```{r}
csome_dims<-read_excel(path="C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/11_GenomeRegions/all/csome_dimensions.xlsx",sheet = "Sheet1")
k=1
for(j in 1:12){
  i=150001
  while(i <= csome_dims[j,3]){
    region<-paste(k,"_Superscaffold",j,"_",(i-150000),"-",i,sep="")
    #load programs
    cat(paste("module load bcftools\n","module load IQ-TREE\n",sep=""), 
        file=paste("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/11_GenomeRegions/all/phy",k,".cmd",sep=""),append=TRUE)
    
    #extract region
    cat(paste("bcftools view -M2 -i 'TYPE!=\"indel\" & QUAL>10 & FMT/DP>8 & FMT/DP<60' -o /cwork/ram163/GENOME_REGIONS/all/",region,".vcf -S /hpc/group/manoslab/QMACROCARPA_GENOMES/00a_SUBSETS/Subset5.2Species99.tsv /hpc/group/manoslab/QMACROCARPA_GENOMES/14_VARIANTS_MONGOLICA/ALL_LIST.gvcf.gz -r Superscaffold",
              j,":",(i-150000),"-",i,"\n",sep=""), 
        file=paste("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/11_GenomeRegions/all/phy",k,".cmd",sep=""),append=TRUE)
    
   #change working directory
     cat(paste("cd /cwork/ram163/GENOME_REGIONS/all/\n",sep=""), 
        file=paste("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/11_GenomeRegions/all/phy",k,".cmd",sep=""),append=TRUE)
   
    #convert to fasta
    cat(paste("vcf2phylip.py -i /cwork/ram163/GENOME_REGIONS/all/",region,".vcf --output-prefix ",region," -m 20 -f\n",sep=""), 
        file=paste("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/11_GenomeRegions/all/phy",k,".cmd",sep=""),append=TRUE)
    
    #run IQ-TREE
    cat(paste("iqtree2 -s ",region,".min20.fasta -nt 5 -pre ",region," -B 1000 -mem 10G\n",sep=""), 
        file=paste("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/11_GenomeRegions/all/phy",k,".cmd",sep=""),append=TRUE)
    
    #root tree
    cat(paste(" pxrr -t ", region,".treefile -g SRR24768763.bam,SRR24768723.bam,SRR24768754.bam,SRR24768716.bam,SRR24768736.bam -o /cwork/ram163/GENOME_REGIONS/all/rooted/", region,".rooted.tre\n",sep=""), 
        file=paste("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/11_GenomeRegions/all/phy",k,".cmd",sep=""),append=TRUE)
    k<-k+1
    i<-i+150000
  }
}
```
